note: Every Skill in this store is an unmodified copy from one of these repositories, at the pinned commit, under its own licence. Edit this file, then run scripts/vendor.mjs. A source whose upstream repository is gone is marked "frozen": its vendored Skills stay as they are and no clone is needed.
reservedNote: Names of the Skills that ship inside Alran Code (dist/assets/skills and the alran agent's skills). A store Skill with one of these names would replace the built-in one, so the vendoring script refuses them.

frozen.reason: The upstream repository was deleted in November 2026. The Skills in the store are the unmodified copies taken at the pinned commit and stay as they are; the source cannot be checked or refreshed until the project publishes them elsewhere.
